watchlist.thesis: AeroVironment's top-priority catalyst for this run — Q1 FY2027 earnings, reported today after market close — resolved as a decisive beat-and-reaffirm: non-GAAP EPS of $0.59 crushed the ~$0.22-0.30 consensus range (a 168% surprise), and record revenue of $480.5 million topped the ~$452-460M consensus, with funded backlog hitting a record $1.5 billion. Yet the stock is trading down roughly 5% in after-hours action to $140.80, as the market is weighing a 21% revenue decline (and swing to an EBITDA loss) in the Space, Cyber and Directed Energy segment against strong 21% growth in Autonomous Systems, plus unchanged (not raised) full-year guidance despite the quarter's magnitude of beat. This is a genuinely mixed reaction to a real, positive fundamental catalyst — the headline numbers are unambiguously strong (record revenue, record backlog, narrower GAAP loss, new $500M Titan award), but the immediate price action argues the market wanted either a guidance raise or cleaner segment performance. Score nudged up from run 15's 6 to 6.5 to reflect the confirmed EPS/revenue beat and record backlog, while status holds at CORE WATCH rather than upgrading further given the after-hours sell-off and SCDE segment weakness; this needs a next-day confirmation check once regular trading opens and the 4:30pm ET call commentary is fully digested.
watchlist.risks: Stock fell in after-hours trading despite the beat, a discordant signal worth monitoring into tomorrow's regular session; Space, Cyber and Directed Energy segment revenue fell 21% and swung to a segment-level EBITDA loss, a real drag on consolidated profitability; full-year guidance was only reaffirmed, not raised, despite the scale of this quarter's beat, which the market may read as caution about back-half execution; elevated inventory ($410.8M) and unbilled receivables ($637.8M) signal rising working-capital intensity; stock is down 24.60% over the trailing month heading into this print; acquisition-accounting charges tied to BlueHalo remain a material drag on GAAP results.
